section.title: Using Factored Form and the Zero Product Property to Solve Quadratic Equations
section.para: We have seen quadratic equations in many different forms. Let’s look at an example in which we find the factored form and then use the zero product property to solve.

Step 3 - Use the zero product property to solve.
